messages:
Asha Patel: Following the postmortem for the 3/2 runtime spike — we need to finalize action owners and due dates. I exported the action list to the doc: https://rwd.link/pm-123. Please confirm ownerships and blockers by EOD tomorrow.

Ravi Menon: I can own the 'model fallback policy' action. ETA: Fri 2026-03-12. Blocker: need SRE validation for rollout test plan.

Maya Li: I'll take the 'telemetry retention / metrics retention' action. ETA: Mon 2026-03-16. Blocker: finance needs to OK the storage bump.

Sam Ortiz: I'll pick up 'canary rollback automation' — needs eng-infra review. Target 2026-03-10. @Lina can you do the infra review?

Lina Gomez: Yep. Will review the infra config by 2026-03-07 and call out any changes. Small tweak expected.

Asha Patel: Great. @Ravi please add your rollout checklist and link a PR in the shared doc. Put exact test plan steps so SRE can run them.

Ravi Menon: Added the checklist and PR: https://rwd.link/pr/456. Left TODOs for SRE smoke tests and expected metrics thresholds.

incident-bot: Postmortem actions created: https://rwd.link/pm-123/actions (6 items). Assigned labels: postmortem, follow-up, sla-impact.

Maya Li: FYI finance flagged the cost increase for telemetry. @Asha can we escalate to product for temporary budget while we confirm retention windows?

Sam Ortiz: There's also a dependency on dedicated capacity — we need confirmation from eng-platform on GPU reserve windows; otherwise canary can't run in target slot.

Lina Gomez: eng-platform leads — can you confirm GPU reservation window for 2026-03-09 through 2026-03-12? If not available we need alternate canary dates.

Asha Patel: Pinging infra leads now. Attaching compact action table for quick reference:

```
Action                              | Owner         | Due       | Blocker
------------------------------------|---------------|-----------|----------------------
Model fallback policy               | Ravi Menon    | 2026-03-12| SRE validation
Telemetry retention increase        | Maya Li       | 2026-03-16| Finance approval
Canary rollback automation          | Sam Ortiz     | 2026-03-10| Infra review
KV cache config adjust              | Lina Gomez    | 2026-03-09| none
Alert threshold tuning              | Asha Patel    | 2026-03-08| metric baselines
```

Asha Patel: Quick asks: (1) owners add PR/link in the doc, (2) call out blockers as single line, (3) if any dates slip >3 business days, flag here so we can re-schedule the next rollout.

Ravi Menon: Confirmed PR + timeline in doc. SRE test cases assigned to @Sam for automation smoke.

Maya Li: Added cost note and tagged FinanceOps in the doc. If FinanceOps doesn't respond by EOD Tuesday, I'll request a temporary credit from Product.

Sam Ortiz: Noted. Will start automation work after infra review. If GPU reservation is confirmed, I'll schedule canary run for 2026-03-10 08:00 PT.

Lina Gomez: Infra review will be done by 2026-03-07 17:00 PT. If anything blocks, I'll post details and suggest fixes.

Asha Patel: Thanks all. I'll collect final confirmations tomorrow morning and set a short triage call only if there are unresolved blockers. Next async check-in: Wed 2026-03-06 11:00 PT. If nothing new, we'll proceed to close actions on the listed dates. :thumbsup:
